title: A tax-lot proposal and missing estate classifications

Compare the proposed sale and supplied records, calculate supported economics, and identify each reviewer's next evidence needs.

Cite material claims. Prepare actual usable draft files for the named recipients; declare the exact recipient set on each report and working artifact. Retain any structured inputs or calculation outputs you use as separately labeled working files with an authorized recipient set. If a required field is not evidenced, keep it unknown or explain the tool limitation while completing supported work. Do not contact anyone, send drafts, place orders, approve a transaction, or change a system.
